scope: Generic dry clutch mechanism reference; not an OEM dimension claim for this Dayun vehicle.

sources.title: SKF Bearings & CR Seals Specification Handbook 2018
sources.finding: Release bearing and release mechanism lift the pressure plate away from the clutch disc to disengage drive.

sources.title: ZF Aftermarket: Clutch does not disengage
sources.finding: Insufficient pressure-plate lift prevents full disengagement; a jammed hub can leave the disc facing in contact with the flywheel. The revised model must demonstrate real separation at friction faces, not only move the release bearing.
